semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: One general real-valued version theorem and three derived causal applications, not four printed Orabona theorems. The field is exactly eventuallyMeasurableSpace F (ae ambient_mu); no identity with completion of mu.trim F is asserted. The real-version result allows arbitrary measures and separate F with no F-below-ambient, finiteness or sample-space regularity premise. The policy result assumes subordinate strict-past information and AE unit predictions, with arbitrary measure and measurable seed space. It yields one classical law-relative measurable policy family, globally unit-valued, with common all-natural-time AE equality; exceptional null samples may differ. Independence additionally needs probability, measurable jointly independent targets and a measurable seed independent of the whole stream, but no bounds, identical laws or moments. The excess identity additionally needs common target laws and AE unit targets/predictions. Its infimum is outside expectation and its mean is an analysis witness. The same process works for every natural horizon including zero. Universal causal kernels, other required information constructions, remaining chapter/book obligations and nine historical literal hash-use obligations remain open.
